title: Statistical assessment of an atmospheric mercury passive sampler at a regional site in South Africa
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00071D, Paper

Xoliswa E. V. Job, Kerneels Jaars, Pieter G. van Zyl, Katrina MacSween, Liezl Bredenkamp, Miroslav Josipovic, Lynwill G. Martin, Ville Vakkari, Markku Kulmala, Lauri Laakso
This study evaluates the Mercury Passive Air Sampler (MerPAS®) as a cost-effective alternative to active sampling for atmospheric mercury monitoring at the Welgegund atmospheric measurement station in South Africa.
